newsitem.title: UK: Stg/mark extends slide in Europe though off lows.
newsitem.headline: Stg/mark extends slide in Europe though off lows.

text.p: 0700 GMT - Sterling extends slump against mark in early Europe, trades more than one pfennig down from late Monday levels but off early lows around 2.9900 marks. Cable steady.
* Stg/mark at 3.0008/13 vs 3.0130/40 in late Europe on Monday, though just above early lows below 2.9900. Sterling seen shaky after tumbling on Monday on a bout of fierce profit-taking.
* Cable touch softer, trading at $1.6330/40 vs $1.6321/26 in late Europe Monday, as dollar retains general strength.
* UK June consumer credit due at 0830 GMT.
